findings.evidence: self_check.save calls target.write_text repeatedly. The exact requested subprocess invocation exited 0 with three passed controls. Replay bytes matched committed SHA256 9b76ed047caf417db5f87f7ea66f682354c84b91f231492d6603ef33ff57f79c exactly; no JSON value differed. Committed bytes remain unchanged. This records the required rewrite finding, not a result mismatch.
